meaning:
ἱκανόω, -ῶ
(ἱκανός), [in LXX chiefly for רַב ;]
to make sufficient, render fit: with dupl. accusative, 2Co.3:6; with accusative of person(s) before εἰς, Col.1:12.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter, but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,
